items.label: FIGURE O.4
items.title: Stalled progress in Global Prosperity Gap reduction
items.content: The chart is a line graph titled 'a. Progress in reducing the Global Prosperity Gap'. The y-axis represents the 'Global Prosperity Gap' ranging from 0 to 12. The x-axis represents years from 1990 to 2024. The trend shows a steady decline in the Global Prosperity Gap from approximately 11 in 1990 to approximately 5 around 2018, after which the progress stalls and remains relatively flat, ending at approximately 5 in 2024. The line from 2022 to 2024 is dashed, indicating a projection or estimate.
